legacyFindings.finding: Legacy progression repeats the same multi-boss elimination objective through escalating xN counts with effectively identical briefing text.
reject: same target set repeated only for larger totals

legacyFindings.finding: Legacy progression repeats Sectant Priest/Warrior elimination through escalating 1/2/5/10/15/20/27/35/50/75 counts with identical briefing structure.
reject: reward escalation solely for higher kill count

legacyFindings.finding: Legacy progression advances primarily by repeating the same target kill at incremental distance thresholds such as 50m, 60m, 70m and onward.
reject: same target/objective repeated at the next distance threshold

legacyFindings.finding: Legacy progression repeats map survival counters such as x2/x5/x10, including failure-on-non-survived variants, with generic briefing text.
reject: same map repeated only for a larger count

authoredArchetypes.purpose: Prove that the player can enter a selected operational area, gather a meaningful field result and leave successfully rather than merely accumulate raid completions.
Demonstrate controlled long-range capability in one authored scenario instead of climbing a distance staircase.
mechanicShape: selected target class or map context
rewardIntent: precision project component or controlled capability progression

authoredArchetypes.purpose: Investigate and disrupt a cultist threat as a contextual night operation, not as a 1-to-75 elimination ladder.
Use a specific boss threat as the objective of an authored contract with target-specific context and payoff rather than requiring repeated kills of every boss.
mechanicShape: named boss or tightly related target set
rewardIntent: distinctive milestone reward or specialist stock access

requirementsBeforeRuntime: exact SPT 4.1.3 condition shape selected and validated
reward envelope compared with vanilla and Economy Admiral evidence
objective is materially distinct from adjacent Admiral quests
no hidden dependency on legacy trader IDs or legacy quest templates
